finally, as i said in my original post i respect people voting 3rd party or even not voting (as long as the motivation isn't just laziness or not wanting to get jury duty) as a protest. however, anyone doing that has to understand that their vote will count for nothing tangible. i prefer to try to lower the amount of evil in the system with my vote.
